feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 14 May 2026 9:04am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 14 May 2026 at 9:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic, and low pressure over Scandinavia, with various troughs affecting the British Isles.


##Wind##

North or northwest force 5 or 6, perhaps decreasing 4 in the east at times, and occasionally increasing 7 for a time in the west this afternoon and evening. Easing 4 or 5 in all waters from dawn tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, but slight to moderate in the far east of the area, and occasionally touching rough in the south and west later this afternoon and early evening. Then becoming slight or moderate in all waters late tonight.


##Weather##

Occasional showers, becoming mainly fair tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 overnight into Saturday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling slight during the afternoon, then smooth or slight overnight into Saturday.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
